brands.name: Guts Surfboards
brands.short_description: Gower, Wales surfboards hand-shaped by two-time European professional surfing champion Chris 'Guts' Griffiths.

models.name: Pro model
models.description: All-round performance longboard developed over five years with low volume and progressive rocker — ridden to five European titles and countless national and international wins. 9'1" x 22" with thruster or 10" box and side fin options.

models.name: White Walker
models.description: Versatile mid-length diamond-tailed quad fin performer from 2 ft to 10 ft with generous volume and a chamfered deck line for smooth carving. 7'6" x 22" with custom sizing available.

models.name: Evil Twin
models.description: Best-selling mid-length twin fin with exceptional paddling, wave catching, and manoeuvrable performance. 7' x 21.5" with custom sizing available.

models.name: UFO
models.description: Next-generation hybrid with extra-wide nose and tail for planing area in a compact length — paddles like a fish with straight rails for critical turns. Blended single concave channel bottom with 4 or 5 fin setup; sizes from 5'6" through 7'.

models.name: Retro Performer
models.description: Classic old-style mal with 50-50 rails, lower rocker, and a 1960s template for traditional logging.

models.name: Pro Nose
models.description: Performance noserider developed with Sam Bleakley, Elliot Dudley, and Joe and Grace Davies to maximize time on the tip in small waves and competition.

models.name: Elfish
models.description: Classic old-school fish — short, fat, and flat with a beak nose and front-loaded volume. Perfect summer groveller that stays fun in more juice. 5'10 x 21" with custom sizing available.

models.name: Mule
models.description: Versatile hybrid shortboard with a diamond tail, full template, single concave, relaxed entry rocker, and quad fin setup — from 2 ft slop to 6 ft barrels. Sizes 6' to 6'10".

models.name: Mullet
models.description: Wide-tailed high-volume board for fish conditions with a straighter tail for more drive and less drift — a performance board under 7' for longboarders. Sizes 6'0 to 6'10" in box and side, twin, or quad setups.
